text: 中国央行公布行政处罚信息显示，广发银行因涉10项违法行为被警告，没收违法所得1.621747万元，罚款1712.4万元。违法行为类型包括：1.违反金融统计管理规定；2.违反账户管理规定；3.违反清算管理规定；4.违反银行卡收单业务管理规定；5.违反数据安全管理规定；6.违反反假货币业务管理规定；7.占压财政存款或者资金；8.违反信用信息采集、提供、查询及相关管理规定；9.未按规定履行客户身份识别义务；10.未按规定报送大额交易报告。
text_en: Administrative penalty information published by the People's Bank of China shows that China Guangfa Bank was warned for involving 10 illegal acts, with illegal gains of 1.621747 million yuan confiscated and a fine of 17.124 million yuan imposed. The types of illegal acts include: 1. violating regulations on financial statistics management; 2. violating regulations on account management; 3. violating regulations on clearing management; 4. violating regulations on bank card acquiring business management; 5. violating regulations on data security management; 6. violating regulations on anti-counterfeit currency business management; 7. occupying or withholding fiscal deposits or funds; 8. violating regulations on the collection, provision, inquiry, and related management of credit information; 9. failing to perform customer identity identification obligations as required; 10. failing to submit large-value transaction reports as required.
